name_note: The GTDB genus Mailhella is much broader than the single cultured species Mailhella massiliensis, most of its species being named only from metagenome-assembled genomes.

sentences.text: The name Mailhella massiliensis was reported for a strain isolated from fresh stool samples of healthy French patients.
A study described a Candidatus Mailhella bacterium of the family Desulfovibrionaceae as likely respiring isethionate.
A 16S rDNA study of stool from 13 skeletal tuberculosis patients and 13 healthy individuals reported a higher abundance of Mailhella in the patients.
A study in mice fed a high-fat diet reported that low-dose ellagic acid inhibited the abundance of Mailhella massiliensis.
